properties.description:
Added deterministic architecture inspection before replacing production request paths. ProjectTools walks executable UI and host dependencies, rejects direct network capabilities in UI and dedicated application routes in UI/host helpers, reports source locations, and fails unresolved executable dependencies. Public engine packages are the explicit capability boundary; ordinary declarative image resources remain valid. No file exemptions.

Validation: three focused fixtures pass, including indirect UI transport, indirect host dispatch, valid public engine access, declarative image resources and missing dependencies. Initial scan: 85 findings; recursively inspecting host helpers expands this to 93. Results are recorded under .harness/engine-boundaries/. Root build, test, browser-test and check entrypoints now run the failing gate. These are known migration findings, not a passing application. Final request-path integration and zero bypass findings remain completion criteria of the cleanup and verification children.
properties.title: Enforce application access through the local engine
